item.title: Tinubu provides important update on $100,000 reward for Super Falcons, D’Tigress
item.description: President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s government has provided a major update on the $100,000 mouthwatering reward for Nigeria’s Super Falcons and D’Tigress.

item.title: Plot to arrest Atiku, Ameachi, Aregbesola, others thickens, group warns
item.description: Office of the National Security Adviser (ONSA) has been accused of an alleged plot to arrest former vice president Atiku Abubakar and other opposition leaders.

item.title: Man shares observation as Davido wins N141m after Super Eagles beat Tanzania 2–1
item.description: A young Nigerian man took to social media to react to popular singer Davido after he won a bet following the Super Eagles’ 2–1 AFCON win over Tanzania.

item.title: Breaking: PDP responds as INEC rules on Wike vs Makinde party dispute
item.description: The PDP on Tuesday evening, December 23, reacted following INEC’s major ruling on the internal party dispute involving Nyesom Ezenwo Wike and Seyi Makinde.

item.title: Accord Party reaffirms expulsion of Imumolen, Absorbs supporters of ex-presidential candidate
item.description: Accord Party reaffirms Prof Christopher Imumolen's expulsion for misconduct, welcoming misled members back, while asserting unity and focus on upcoming elections.

item.title: AFCON 2025: Nigerians disagree with CAF's MOTM pick after Super Eagles' 2-1 victory against Tanzania
item.description: Semi Ajayi named Man of the Match as Nigeria defeats Tanzania 2-1. Controversy arises among fans favouring Alex Iwobi's two assists for the award.

item.title: Nigerian lady who promised not to forgive Jesus shares her story, people react
item.description: A video making the rounds on social media has captured the moment a Nigerian lady shared her experience after denouncing Jesus. Netizens reacted massively.

item.title: Breaking: Tears, lamentation as Libyan army chiefs killed in plane crash
item.description: The Libyan Prime Minister Abdulhamid Dbeibah has confirmed the killing of the country's army's chief of staff, Mohammed Ali Ahmed Al-Haddad, in a plane crash.

item.title: Watch moment lady clashed with airport staff after they insisted that she's not Nigerian
item.description: A video making the rounds on social media has captured the moment a Nigerian lady got into a serious argument with airport staff over her nationality.

item.title: Breaking: INEC breaks silence on PDP leadership crisis between Wike and Makinde
item.description: Nigeria's electoral body, INEC has taken the final position between Nyesom Wike and Seyi Makinde factions in the PDP amid the rift between the opposition leaders.
